description:
List chatbot knowledge sources

Returns every knowledge source attached to one chatbot. Only the first 100 characters of each entry are returned, as `contentSnippet`; the full stored text is never sent by this endpoint. The response is a plain list with no paging. Entries belong to the account that owns the chatbot, so a reseller key that reads a customer chatbot sees the same entries as the customer.
name: list_chatbot_knowledge
title: List chatbot knowledge sources
